items.title: File objection (Widerspruch) against the care grade 2 decision
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 2025-03-28, sent by ordinary post. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting (posted from 2025): Tue 2025-04-01. The one-month period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on 2025-05-01 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). That day is Labour Day, a public holiday, so the deadline moves to Fri 2025-05-02 (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X, § 64 Abs. 3 SGG). The objection must reach the Pflegekasse, or another domestic authority or social insurance body, by then.

warnings: If the letter was formally served (yellow envelope or a stated service date) instead of sent by ordinary post, the period runs from that date and the deadline may be earlier.

Today's date is given as 2025-03-30 in the task, but the tool's context shows 2026-09-30. If today is really 2026-09-30, the objection deadline of 2025-05-02 has already passed, so check the facts (for example the actual delivery date) and get advice promptly.
The letter says the Pflegegeld of 347,00 € is paid monthly at the end of each month from February 2025. It gives no other dates.
